# `Q-2-58` — Quarto 1 diagram cell is not run

> Quarto 2 does not run `{mermaid}` or `{dot}` cells. The block renders as
> a code block, not a diagram.

## What this means

Quarto 1 draws diagrams from executable cells, written with braces:
```` ```{mermaid} ```` and ```` ```{dot} ````. Quarto 2 draws diagrams
from the plain fences ```` ```mermaid ```` and ```` ```dot ````. A
brace-form cell is left as a code block, so the reader sees the diagram's
source instead of the diagram.

## How to fix

**For Mermaid**, drop the braces. The diagram body and its `%%|` options
need no other change:

`````markdown
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Draft] --> B[Review]
```
`````

**For Graphviz (`{dot}`)**, drop the braces in the same way. The diagram
body and its `//|` options need no other change:

`````markdown
```dot
digraph G {
  Draft -> Review
}
```
`````

Graphviz diagrams are drawn in the `html` and `revealjs` formats. In
other formats a `dot` block is still shown as its source.

**If an engine handles the brace form**, this warning does not apply to
the cells it claims. If you still see it, or want it gone, turn it off in
`_quarto.yml` or the document's front matter:

```yaml
diagnostics:
  Q-2-58:
    level: off
    reason: "our engine renders {dot} cells"
```

## Example

Bad input (Quarto 1 idiom):

`````markdown
```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Draft] --> B[Review]
```
`````

Corrected:

`````markdown
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Draft] --> B[Review]
```
`````
